description:
Log in to Moodle as admin (username: admin, password: Admin1234!) at http://localhost/moodle.

Navigate to the course "Introduction to Biology" (BIO101) and configure the gradebook with weighted grade categories:

1. Go to the Gradebook setup page (via Grades in the course navigation, then choose "Gradebook setup" or the Setup tab).
2. Edit the top-level course grade category and change the Aggregation method to "Weighted mean of grades".
3. Add a new grade category named "Lab Reports".
4. Add a new grade category named "Exams".
5. Set the weights for the categories:
   - Lab Reports: weight 40
   - Exams: weight 60
6. Save all changes.

The final gradebook should show the course using weighted mean aggregation with two sub-categories having weights that sum to 100.
